name: Kolibri
description: Offline-first learning platform from Learning Equality — self-hosted STEM and literacy content for ages 5-18. Classroom-capable, LAN-sync built in, thousands of free educational channels curated by the global learning community.
author: Crow

env_vars.name: KOLIBRI_URL
env_vars.description: Internal URL for reaching the Kolibri API.

env_vars.name: KOLIBRI_DATA_PATH
env_vars.description: Host path to persist Kolibri content and SQLite DB (defaults to a named volume).

env_vars.name: KOLIBRI_HTTP_PORT
env_vars.description: Host port to expose Kolibri on. Default 8041 (Kolibri's own default 8080 is a common conflict on home servers).

env_vars.name: KOLIBRI_FACILITY_NAME
env_vars.description: Facility name Crow creates at install (default `Home Lab`). Kolibri itself does not read this variable; Crow's setup script does.

notes: Crow creates the superuser `admin` (password in Settings → Passwords) and a facility at install, so Kolibri's own first-run wizard never has to be claimed. Content is stored under the container's /kolibri (its KOLIBRI_HOME) — installs made before this bundle mounted that path never started a container at all, so changing the mount loses no content. Channels are then imported in Kolibri from Kolibri Studio or from a LAN peer. Sized for a Raspberry Pi 4 (512 MB floor); a full primary-grade STEM bundle typically imports 5-10 GB of channels. Kolibri has LAN-sync built in — two instances on the same network auto-discover each other for offline classrooms.
